name: Foilmettle
description: Spread the arms like pinions and hold the blade at the end of the longest arc the body can make.

name: Gustswept
description: Step and glide on the toes with the weight carried high so the gap closes in silence.

name: Remnant Cupedge
description: Gaze at the foe from beyond his reach and read where his next step will land.

name: Tempered Volte
description: Lean out from the hip in a reaching stoop and thrust at a foe who believes himself out of range.

name: Evergreen Tipwhip
description: Brush the thrust aside with the flat of the forte and return along the same pinion line.

name: Lungespine
description: Cast the blade's shadow across the foe's face while the point arrives from the opposite side.

name: Rumble Counterpoise
description: Circle the point about the foe in slowly narrowing rings then loose it in a stoop through the opening.

name: Maiming Pasguard
description: Beat the foe's blade with a pulse like a wingbeat and send the point through the gap it makes.

name: Nova Whipblade
description: Cross the whole gap in a flash of qi and land the point before the foe has seen the lunge begin.

name: Facetpas
description: Raise the blade to the brow in the courtesy of the court and drop it into guard in one smooth line.

name: Mightpas
description: Pace forward on the two courts of the body in turn so the weight is always ready to lunge.

name: Waning Slimtang
description: Watch the foe's blade and his eyes as a pair and let neither one slip from notice.

name: Cuphilt Reckoning
description: Thrust along the court line with no wave of the shoulder so the foe must read the hip.

name: Devastating Passata
description: Thrust and thrust again along one line so the second follows the first like an echo.

name: Pasdurance
description: Sweep the forte broadly across the court of the body to clear two thrusts at once.

name: Gyve Needlepoint
description: Bind the foe's blade with two points of pressure and hold it from both sides of the line.

name: Ironlunge
description: Send a point of qi at the foe's guard and strike with the steel where the guard has just moved.

name: Equipoise Sweephilt
description: Deflect the foe's thrust with one hand of field and answer with the other in the same beat.

name: Wrathful Tempered Remise
description: Split one lunge into two tracks of qi so the second pierces whatever the foe's parry has covered.

name: Pasnerve
description: Stand with the blade moving in a slow loose arc so the guard never rests in one place.

name: Remisevortex
description: Step back as the foe presses in the way a stream bends around a bank.

name: Chimeswept
description: Read the foe's intent from small ripples in his shoulders and hips as from water in a basin.

name: Lacerating Fleche
description: Send out a quick thrust that spreads like a ripple so the foe's parry meets nothing.

name: Flintlike Needlepoint
description: Carry the parry on into the riposte as one continuous flow of the blade with no stop between.

name: Webbing Cuphilt
description: Wind the blade round the foe's in a tightening spiral until it is drawn from his line.

name: Voltescourge
description: Pull the foe's attention one way with the blade and lunge from beneath like a hidden undertow.

name: Flintlike Counterpoise
description: Meet a hard thrust with a yielding turn and send its full force back along the foe's own arm.

name: Pitiless Stoccata
description: Draw the point back slowly like an ebbing tide then release it in a single surge at the throat.

name: Lacerating Passata
description: Let a flood of qi follow the lunge so it breaks the foe's guard and drives him from his ground.

name: Hoarfrost Tipwhip
description: Hold the blade and the field before the body like two hands matched in one guard.

name: Granite Fleche
description: Send the field ahead of the foot and let the body follow it into each new position.

name: Buoying Sweephilt
description: Compare what the steel feels with what the field feels and notice where the two disagree.

name: Forged Remise
description: Thrust with the steel and keep the field held back for a second blow.

name: Obdurate Slimtang
description: Brush the foe's blade with the field alone to turn it without letting steel touch steel.

name: Murk Pasguard
description: Parry with the steel and answer with a narrow thrust of field qi into the foe's open ribs.

name: Fastening Volte
description: Pin the foe's blade with the field and cut across his wrist with the edge of the steel.

name: Tempered Stoccata
description: Lunge on a pace of steel and a pace of field so each carries the other forward.

name: Rumble Cupedge
description: Join blade and field in a single thrust whose force the foe cannot meet with one parry.

name: Gustpas
description: Press down on the foe's blade with the field as it is parried so he cannot lift it for a second thrust.

name: Novapas
description: Seal every line but one with the field and thrust down the last one with the steel.

name: Unrelenting Whipblade
description: Stand with the point on one track and the weight on the other ready to move along either.

name: Volte Vortex
description: Advance by two measured paces that keep the point on its first track while the feet find the second.

name: Verityfoil
description: Watch both of the foe's tracks in turn and feel which one he trusts when he is pressed.

name: Nova Lunge
description: Thrust along the first track at a speed that draws the foe's parry to that side.

name: Needlepoint Valor
description: Parry on the second track so a thrust meant for the open side finds the blade instead.

name: Remnant Fleche
description: Slip from one track to the other beneath the foe's parry and thrust where he no longer guards.

name: Gyve Pasguard
description: Lay the first track upon the second so the foe's blade is locked between your two lines.

name: Granite Sweephilt
description: Press on both tracks together with the point and the pace until the foe can answer neither.

name: Murk Whipblade
description: Trade tracks mid-parry so the riposte arrives from a line the foe has just left unguarded.

name: Hourvolte
description: Run a thrust down the first track and the second at once so both fall upon the foe together.

name: Charter Bellguard
description: Meet the foe's driving force on both tracks at once so his thrust arrives spent and harmless.

name: Glintpas
description: Run both tracks to their farthest reach in one thrust so the point arrives wherever the guard is not.

name: Unbudging Bellguard
description: Hold the blade high and the body tall like a hawk upon a peak looking down at its quarry.

name: Might Remise
description: Let the front foot drop forward from a height so the body falls into the lunge.

name: Verity Bellguard
description: Hold the gaze high and wide and take in the foe's whole stance before choosing the line.

name: Corroding Tipwhip
description: Throw the whole body down the line in a plummeting lunge with qi gathered at the point.

name: Unrelenting Counterpoise
description: Fold the arm close to the ribs and turn the blade inward to sweep a thrust off the flank.

name: Reverie Passata
description: Raise the point toward the foe's brow to lift his guard then drop it to the open belly.

name: Cuphilt Wrath
description: Gather qi above the foe with the blade raised and loose it in one falling thrust through his guard.

name: Nova Slimtang
description: Strike at the foe's blade and chest in the same drop then rise out of the exchange before he answers.

name: Facet Tipwhip
description: Plunge from such height and speed that the point passes the guard and pins the foe's stance.

name: Iron Cupedge
description: Hold the blade at full extension on the guard line so the foe must pass the whole length of steel.

name: Pasblink
description: Move in short paces on a held breath so the guard stays level through every step.

name: Revitalizing Slimtang
description: Read the small gaps that open in the guard as the foe shifts and judge when they widen.

name: Foilvalor
description: Turn the foe's thrust off the long guard and return the point down the same line.

name: Mayhem Needlepoint
description: Beat the foe's blade with a pulse of qi so it rings away from the guard line.

name: Foilnerve
description: Shift the long guard across to the other side in one sweep that carries a thrust wide.

name: Aegisswept
description: Throw a second blade of qi along the steel so the foe cannot tell which edge to fear.

name: Unbudging Cuphilt
description: Let the long guard fall into a thrust at the instant the foe's blade is turned.

name: Unbowed Glamour Pasguard
description: Meet the foe's strongest attack with a guard that throws its force back and follows it with the point.

name: Unassailable Sweephilt
description: Plant the feet as if sworn to the ground and hold the point steady upon the foe.

name: Mightswept
description: Walk the high flat ground in long level paces that keep the shoulders and the point unmoved.

name: Clairvoyant Whipblade
description: Look past the foe to the far line of the plateau and judge his motion against it.

name: Nova Remise
description: Thrust and hold the extension a full beat as though the oath bound the arm in place.

name: Flintlike Cupedge
description: Brush the foe's blade aside with a light sideways stroke like wind across grass.

name: Hellish Stoccata
description: Step forward with the point fixed on the foe's chest and let him give ground or be struck.

name: Intent Stoccata
description: Keep the point upon the foe through every parry and turn so his movements are all made under it.

name: Voltewrath
description: Gather the long wind of the plateau into the lunge and loose it with the point leading.

name: Glint Lunge
description: Cross the final span in a flash of sworn qi and strike once so that the duel is ended.

name: Ironswept
description: Lean the body into the foe as into a wind and hold the blade braced before it.

name: Volteglare
description: Pace forward against the foe's pressure with the head low and every step planted flat.

name: Energizing Bellguard
description: Feel how the foe's weight leans on the air between you and guess his next advance.

name: Nova Volte
description: Thrust at the very front of the foe's gust of motion before it has fully formed.

name: Rumble Passata
description: Lunge straight into the foe's advance so his own force drives him onto the point.

name: Invincible Counterpoise
description: Slice the point across the foe's blade like a sharp draft and turn it from the line.

name: Mayhem Volte
description: Beat the foe's blade from the windward side so it swings out of his hand's control.

name: Corroding Needlepoint
description: Hold the lunge while the field gathers behind the point like a rising gale then release it.

name: Granite Stoccata
description: Slip to the lee side of the foe's thrust and lunge into his flank from the shelter of his own arm.

name: Shattering Cuphilt
description: Lunge with every pulse of the field driving the point so that the thrust lands with a gale's weight.

name: Aegis Tipwhip
description: Take a bearing on the foe and settle the guard to it so the body never loses its direction.

name: Lunge Rocketry
description: Turn on the rear foot like a needle on its pivot to keep the point on the bearing.

name: Verity Counterpoise
description: Check the bearing against a far ridge by day or a fixed star by night.

name: Nova Passata
description: Thrust exactly along the bearing so the point finds the centre of the foe's chest.

name: Chimepas
description: Parry without letting the blade leave the bearing so the answering thrust is already aimed.

name: Pasruin
description: Keep the bearing through a full turn of the body and lunge at the end of it.

name: Numbing Slimtang
description: Cross the foe's bearing with your own and bind his blade at the point of crossing.

name: Hourremise
description: Walk along the bearing toward the foe with the point level and force him off his own.

name: Immobilizing Sweephilt
description: Break the foe's bearing with a sharp beat of qi and thrust before he can take another.

name: Iron Pasguard
description: Lunge so truly along the bearing that no turn of the foe's body can take the point off him.

name: Shattering Bellguard
description: Drive a seal of qi along the bearing ahead of the point so the foe's lines close behind it.

name: Aegis Whipblade
description: Hold a light loose guard that looks thin as a cloak but turns the first thrust cleanly.

name: Dazzling Cuphilt
description: Pass the foe on the open side in one quick step like a gale passing a tree.

name: Energizing Cupedge
description: Feel through the point where the foe's guard is thin and a draft could pass.

name: Iron Remise
description: Prick through the loose cloth over the foe's arm to cut the sinew beneath it.

name: Facet Counterpoise
description: Narrow the qi to a needle along the blade and thrust through the foe's thinnest cover.

name: Murk Needlepoint
description: Roll the blade in a wide quick turn that sweeps thrusts away like a wind rolling dust.

name: Maiming Remise
description: Beat the middle of the foe's guard so that it swings open and leaves the chest bare.

name: Glint Bellguard
description: Send the thrust through the foe's guard on a rush of qi as wind passes through a thin garment.

name: Toxin Sweephilt
description: Lift the foe's guard with a surge of force from beneath so his arm is thrown up and wide.

name: Eviscerating Facet Cupedge
description: Flash through the guard so swiftly that the foe's blade finds only the place where the point had been.

name: Thornswept
description: Rest the blade low and easy in the way of the masters so the foe misjudges what it guards.

name: Pasglare
description: Pace on a measured sworn breath so each step falls exactly where the oath requires.

name: Tempered Pasguard
description: Listen to the quiet of the open plateau and pick out the faint scrape of the foe's boot.

name: Voltehavoc
description: Deliver a short economical thrust with no visible windup from the masters' easy guard.

name: Gust Whipblade
description: Parry in a round easy turn of the wrist that spends the foe's strength in the air.

name: Facet Slimtang
description: Lunge along a sworn bearing and let the point land only where the oath allows.

name: Ponderous Passata
description: Tie the foe's blade in a quick knot of steel and qi and pull it from his line.

name: Glamour Stoccata
description: Swear with the point to the foe's eyes then withdraw it to strike the line he abandons.

name: Flintlike Pasguard
description: Parry on the in-breath and riposte on the out-breath in the slow certain rhythm of the plateau.

name: Flechehavoc
description: Hold the long thrust in readiness while the oath gathers qi then deliver it as one unbroken line.

name: Indomitable Tipwhip
description: Still the foe's attack with a calm turn of the point so that his gathered force finds nothing to strike.

name: Remise Reckoning
description: Pour every sworn breath into a single thrust that ends the exchange before the foe's answer begins.

name: Counterpoise Valor
description: Stand wide and low on open ground with the point level so no flank is left uncovered.

name: Headlong Fleche
description: Run in wide strides across the plain with the point leading and the arm steady.

name: Cuphilt Insight
description: Fix a far mark beyond the foe and judge the distance to him against it.

name: Sweephilt Wrath
description: Thrust at the end of the run with the speed of the whole body in the point.

name: Indomitable Bellguard
description: Parry with a long sweep of the arm that uses all the room the open ground allows.

name: Foilspine
description: Show the foe a lunge from too far away and close the true gap in the instant he relaxes.

name: Volte Devastation
description: Gather qi over a long run and loose it as a single thrust that crosses a wide stretch of ground.

name: Flecheglare
description: Let a push of qi at the back speed the run so the lunge arrives a breath early.

name: Torrential Tipwhip
description: Flash across a distance that seems to reach the horizon and land the point on the foe's heart.

name: Aegisfoil
description: Hold a high open guard under the sky with nothing behind the body to lean upon.

name: Whipblade Whirlpool
description: Step freely about the foe while the point holds to its bearing without a pause.

name: Verity Slimtang
description: Mark the wind on the skin and use it to judge how the foe's thrust will drift.

name: Foilwrath
description: Thrust without cover or retreat in view and trust the bearing alone to guide the point.

name: Chime Cupedge
description: Turn the foe's thrust with a broad parry and return the point along the line it gives.

name: Pasguard Nerve
description: Turn the whole body about the bearing as a vane turns and sweep the thrust wide.

name: Granite Lunge
description: Hold the point on the open line between you and give the foe no room to cross it.

name: Aegis Needlepoint
description: Spread a shelter of qi from the point so the foe's thrusts fail without any wall to block them.

name: Ruinous Volte
description: Drive the point home along the held bearing with the force of the whole body behind it.

name: Impervious Sweephilt
description: Return the weight of the foe's thrust along the bearing and meet him with the point in the same instant.
